## 9. How to sign

To sign this agreement, post this exact comment in a pull request to the project:

```text

```

The CLA check records your GitHub account, the pull request and the date in `signatures/version1/cla.json` on the `cla-signatures` branch. Your signature covers all your Contributions, before and after the date that you sign.
